scope: offline raw-log invariant audit, not new inference or statistics
matched_denominator: matched/(hits+incomplete+d0_mismatch); successful-hit mean unavailable from existing logs
memory_boundary: peak_bytes is bounded owned payload (1884160) plus object_bytes 192; allocator, existing host history, driver allocations, RSS and page cache separate; overlapping RSS/NVML/global values must not be summed
release_boundary: release_ns measures unique_ptr Reset host duration; no claim physical RAM immediately returned to OS
index_boundary: indexed at suffix release before plain tail; expected initial prompt plus weighted accepted input counts, not all emitted output or pending correction
sampling_boundary: one-second samples can miss transients; system totals include outside processes; stage maxima cannot establish attributable suffix RAM delta
